rationale: The hint changes because cloud material needs drawn frames, while the sharp glint is cheaper and more tunable as a gradient layer.

design_guidelines.artistic_direction: A painterly deep-space cloud with one precise travelling star glint.
design_guidelines.concept_twist: The familiar nebula vista becomes a continuous role-aware snake surface rather than a rectangular sky scene.
design_guidelines.body_strategy: Cloud masses simplify at 4 cells, establish depth by 6-7 cells, and repeat over long turns while the procedural glint and head glow preserve head priority.
design_guidelines.asset_strategy: Request a production-quality 20 fps translucent sheet with 60 derived rows; x and final-to-zero y joins must be seamless and row zero calm.

layer_plan: Outline and Body fallback ribbons preserve team reading
Nebula sheet is translucent above Body fallback

asset_plan.prompt: 848x960 grid: 53 body cells by 60 frame rows, translucent art and no gutters or baked contour; x and final-to-zero y seamless, row zero calm, clouds morph in place.

animation_plan: Move the glint gradient with tri(time) on the same document clock
risks: Opaque generated pixels could bury role cues
Two motions may compete at game scale
